name: LITD Blender Modeling Common Contract v52
purpose: Transformer les dossiers maîtres v51 en instructions Blender exécutables sans prétendre créer les assets artistiques hors Blender.
rigging_order: add IK/FK or procedural controls only where useful to authoring
f3_test_protocol: force the target segment to be functionally unusable in pose/animation
remove or disable incompatible attached equipment
verify weight redistribution or locomotion compensation at gameplay camera distance
verify no neighboring BODY segment collapses or stretches implausibly
verify transition back to F0 is not used as an accidental healing animation
f4_test_protocol: hide or remove target BODY segment
activate matching STUMP geometry when required
remove attached equipment on destroyed anatomy
run idle, locomotion and at least one combat Action with the segment absent
verify silhouette remains readable from gameplay camera distance
verify no virtual limb, hidden duplicate or phase transition recreates the destroyed part

lod_protocol.LOD0: approved gameplay mesh at the v51 triangle target
lod_protocol.LOD1: preserve silhouette, damage boundaries, sockets and major material breaks; remove secondary folds and small ornaments first
lod_protocol.LOD2: preserve silhouette and BODY/STUMP readability; collapse micro-ornament and simplify hidden joint geometry aggressively

godot_export_preflight: perform human visual review on target mobile framing
truth_rule: A v52 plan is only an executable production recipe. It is not a finished 3D model, rig, animation or Godot-ready asset until the real Blender file has artist-authored geometry, rigging and Actions and passes the v50 Godot validation.
